papers.title: Rethinking Cross-Layer Information Routing in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a de facto backbone of modern visual generation. The residual stream that governs how information accumulates across layers has been directly inherited from the original Transformer. We present a systematic empirical analysis of cross-layer information flow in DiTs and propose Diffusion-Adaptive Routing (DAR).

papers.title: SciAtlas: A Large-Scale Knowledge Graph for Automated Scientific Research
papers.abstract: We introduce SciAtlas, a large-scale, multi-disciplinary, heterogeneous academic resource knowledge graph designed as a panoramic scientific evolution network. By integrating over 43M papers from 26 disciplines, and a total of 157M entities and 3B triplets, SciAtlas provides a structured topological cognitive substrate.

papers.title: StepAudio 2.5 Technical Report
papers.abstract: StepAudio 2.5 is a unified audio-language foundation model that matches or exceeds specialized systems across ASR, TTS, and realtime spoken interaction. We advance the post-training paradigm from standard supervised learning to task-tailored Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF).

papers.title: See What I Mean: Aligning Vision and Language Representations for Video Fine-grained Object Understanding
papers.abstract: We present SWIM (See What I Mean), a novel training strategy that aligns vision and language representations to enable fine-grained object understanding solely from textual prompts. Unlike existing approaches that require explicit visual prompts, SWIM leverages mask supervision only during training.

papers.title: PhotoFlow: Agentic 3D Virtual Photography Missions
papers.abstract: Virtual photography asks an agent to enter a prepared 3D scene, infer a suitable shot from scene information and a language intent, choose executable camera parameters, and render the final photograph. We introduce PhotoFlow, a Director-Reviewer-Reflector agent for closed-loop camera search.

papers.title: VGenST-Bench: A Benchmark for Spatio-Temporal Reasoning via Active Video Synthesis
papers.abstract: We introduce VGenST-Bench, a video benchmark that employs generative models to actively synthesize highly controlled and diverse evaluation scenarios. We propose a multi-agent pipeline incorporating a human quality control stage, ensuring the quality of all generated videos and QA pairs.

papers.title: RankE: End-to-End Post-Training for Discrete Text-to-Image Generation with Decoder Co-Evolution
papers.abstract: We propose RankE, the first end-to-end post-training framework for discrete T2I generation. Rather than optimizing the policy against a fixed decoder, RankE co-evolves both components through alternating optimization: each module maximizes a ranking-based alignment objective.

papers.title: SCOPE: Simulating Cross-game Operations in Playable Environments for FPS World Models
papers.abstract: We propose SCOPE, which inserts a conditioning module into each transformer block of a pretrained video diffusion model for FPS games. It reshapes features into per-pixel temporal sequences so that each position computes its action response from local visual content.

papers.title: Geo-Align: Video Generation Alignment via Metric Geometry Reward
papers.abstract: We propose Geo-Align, the first Reinforcement Learning framework specifically designed for camera-controlled video re-rendering. We optimize the model through a scale-aware perceptual reward mechanism using a metric 3D estimator to extract precise camera trajectories.

papers.title: LatentUMM: Dual Latent Alignment for Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract: We propose LatentUMM, a framework that constructs an enhanced shared latent space to explicitly align transformations and improve cross-modal consistency. LatentUMM consists of dual latent alignment and latent dynamics stabilization stages.

cc_updates.body: `/usage` now shows a per-category breakdown of what's driving your limits usage — skills, subagents, plugins, and per-MCP-server cost. `/diff` detail view can now be scrolled with the keyboard (arrows, `j`/`k`, `PgUp`/`PgDn`, `Space`, `Home`/`End`). Markdown output now renders GFM task list checkboxes (`- [ ] todo` / `- [x] done`) instead of plain bullets. Enterprise: added the `allowAllClaudeAiMcps` managed setting to load claude.ai cloud MCP connectors alongside `managed-mcp.json`. Fixed a PowerShell permission bypass: built-in `cd` functions changed the working directory undetected, letting a later command read outside the workspace.
Fixed the Bash tool returning exit code 127 on every command for some users (a regression introduced in 2.1.147)
